references.notes: Firefly Contractors & Design — the canonical MLA reference. Even though it's a roofing/remodeling brand, every structural pattern (fixed section order, two-column hero with calendar, editorial two-tone eyebrow + serif H2s, service tiles, WhyChooseUs with CSS-mask icons, UsVsThem, sub-services check bullets, /book calendar page) applies 1:1 to concrete. Swap accent color / photography / copy for the vertical.
references.note_url_fragility: This URL may move when the site is attached to a permanent domain. If the URL 404s, cross-reference the template repo directly at ai-website-builder/astro-templates/firefly/ for the current shape.

references.notes: AGC Concrete — native concrete-vertical reference for the editorial type treatment, section rhythm, earth-tone palette, and real-photography approach. Use for concrete-specific color/photography direction; use Firefly for structural patterns.

anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
